welcome.title: Welcome to Rea
welcome.body: A calm space to explore your cycle at your own pace. What you log stays on your phone, just for you.
welcome.privacy: Your data never leaves your device. You can export or erase it whenever you want.

birthYear.title: What year were you born?
birthYear.body: The year is enough to tailor the content you will see. Nothing more.

lastPeriod.title: Your last period
lastPeriod.body: When did your last period start? It is the starting point for your predictions.
lastPeriod.helper: If it has not ended yet, leave it blank.

cycle.title: Your cycle length
cycle.body: It is only a starting point; Rea will refine it with each entry.
cycle.cycleLengthLabel: Days between one period and the next
cycle.helper: Not sure? Leave 5 and 28; we will adjust them together.

regularity.title: How regular is your cycle?
regularity.body: No pressure: choose what feels closest to your reality.

regular.label: Regular
regular.caption: It almost always arrives when I expect it

variable.label: Variable
variable.caption: Sometimes it comes earlier or later

irregular.label: Irregular
irregular.caption: It changes quite a lot from month to month

unsure.label: I am not sure yet
unsure.caption: I will discover it over time

contraception.title: Do you use hormonal contraception?
contraception.body: Pill, hormonal IUD, implant, shot... It changes how Rea interprets your cycle.

options.yes: Yes, I use a hormonal method

contraception.note: If you do, Rea still tracks your symptoms and bleeding, but it will not mark natural fertile days.

goal.title: What do you want from Rea?
goal.body: You can change this whenever you want.

track.label: Understand my cycle
track.caption: Learn about my body and anticipate changes

notifications.title: Gentle reminders
notifications.body: We check in on you without pressure. You decide when.
notifications.helper: By default, from 09:00 to 22:00 every 6 hours.

import.title: Import my data
import.body: Restore a backup and continue right where you left off.

complete.title: All set
complete.body: Thanks for letting us be with you. From here on, Rea learns with you.
complete.disclaimer: Rea does not diagnose and is not a contraceptive method. Its estimates depend on what you log.

unknown.label: Phase to estimate
unknown.caption: Log a few days to refine your prediction

follicular.label: Follicular phase
follicular.caption: Your energy is on the rise

luteal.label: Luteal phase
luteal.caption: The body prepares and slows down

summary.title: Today's summary
summary.body: Here you will see mood, energy, stress, pain and top symptom chips from your check-in. (Still waiting to be connected to real data.)
